name: vault-eta
description: Times every step of every Claude Code run, with its agent, model, tokens and cost at API prices, logs one row per turn to .vault-eta/runs/, and shows an ETA learned from past runs in a band above the prompt and a side pane (/eta).

cacheWriteTtl.title: Cache write TTL
cacheWriteTtl.description: Live usage has no 1h/5m split of cache writes, so they are priced at this TTL. 1h (the default) is what interactive sessions use.

ignoreSkills.title: Skills that do not name a task
ignoreSkills.description: Comma-separated skills skipped when naming a run's task type. Empty by default: a skill that only hands over to another skill is skipped on its own. Add a skill here when one still names runs it should not.

reportPath.title: Report file
reportPath.description: Where /eta report writes the note, relative to the folder the logs live under. An absolute path or a path that climbs out with .. is refused. Rewritten whole each time.

projectsFolder.title: Projects folder
projectsFolder.description: The vault folder that holds one folder per project, relative to the vault (for example Projects or Work/Projects). Empty detects a top-level folder called projects, in any case, with an optional number prefix (01-Projects, 1 Projects).
